title: All Easter Heads
description: Add an Advancement tab to show you how to get Easter Egg Heads from the datapack All Mob Heads.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b285c042087d16a9cc8b1067e01b1341aed3f158.png)
## Loot every easter egg heads from the datapack All Mob Heads !

This datapack only add an Advancement tab to show you how to get the easter egg heads from All Mob Heads datapack.

You need to install the All Mob Heads datapack to be able to access the advancement tab

![Tab Advancement](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f60112c0eae2bcfff75e6ac2d602f71e1d7fa7c9.png)
